## `src/error.rs`

### enum `Error`

Everything the marketplace can refuse to do.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error(transparent)]
    Config(ConfigError),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(std::io::Error),
    #[error("invalid marketplace name {0:?}: {rule}", rule = adi_config::NAME_RULE)]
    InvalidName(String),
    #[error("a marketplace url must start with https:// — got {0:?}")]
    NotHttps(String),
    #[error( "a marketplace named {0} is already configured — remove it first, or pick another name" )]
    Duplicate(String),
    #[error("no marketplace named {0} — add one with `adi-mono marketplace add`")]
    UnknownSource(String),
    #[error("{0:?} names no app — install takes <marketplace>/<app-slug>, e.g. adi/crm")]
    BadSpec(String),
    #[error("app slug {0:?} is not a single safe path segment: {rule}", rule = adi_config::NAME_RULE)]
    BadSlug(String),
    #[error("no cached manifest for {0} — run `adi-mono marketplace sync` first")]
    NotSynced(String),
    #[error("{0} carries no app named {1} — it carries: {2}")]
    UnknownApp(String, String, String),
    #[error( "a dashboard named {0} is already there ({1}) — reinstall over it with `--force`, which \ replaces its files" )]
    Collision(String, String),
    #[error("the artifact for {0} is not a valid dashboard bundle: {1}")]
    BadArtifact(String, String),
    #[error("{0}")]
    Fetch(String),
    #[error( "no dashboard named {0} is installed — `adi-mono marketplace install <marketplace>/{0}` first" )]
    NotInstalled(String),
}
```

### type `Result`

The outcome alias every fallible operation answers with.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

## `src/lib.rs`

### struct `Marketplace`

The handle: the store's `Config`, nothing more. Cheap to build; every operation opens what it needs from disk, so two handles in one process cannot disagree about state the way a cached listing would.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Marketplace {
    config: Config,
}
```
